opening.argument: The speaker presents Forsage through unusually large same-day income claims: “The system offered $185” and “5 to 7 thousand for at least single day.” Those figures are paired with direct recruitment instructions. Viewers are told, “Then you should reply to the person which got this status Join one free meeting,” and are invited to “Be a part of our team.” The visible instruction “For joining In forsage” reinforces that the income claims are being used to bring viewers into the system and team, rather than offered as neutral commentary.
